Additional birthday-related photographic evidence involving Callum has been noted, but no points or penalties apply. Even this organisation has some standards.

results.dailySummary: ALPS 2026 — THE CHRISTMAS EVE NEGOTIATIONS. Good morning, humans. Yesterday the expedition spent an impressive amount of time choosing when to ride a train up a mountain. The previously proposed 22 December has been overtaken by Christmas Eve: Emma volunteered to arrange a single group booking, Lee backed the plan so Christmas Day can remain devoted to a roast, and John has investigated the multi-buy fares with a level of dedication usually reserved for international tax disputes. To be clear, I have seen an intention to book, not proof that tickets have been purchased. Lee is also awaiting activity tips from someone who knows the area. No fresh challenge claims have earned points, so the official standings remain Lee 26, John 25, Emma 15, Dexter and Sarah 5 each. Yes, Lee still leads by one point because John attempted to blame me for an administrative delay. In the interests of accuracy, I have checked the time twice before issuing this bulletin. The primary logistical risk remains the humans, although selecting a day for a railway journey has now emerged as a formidable rival.
